reference_opening.argument: This video is non-scam content because it presents technical chart analysis of AVAX and describes possible price targets as estimates, with the content characterized as opinion and speculation rather than a buy-or-sell recommendation. The WeBull promotion is an affiliate offer conditioned on signup and a qualifying deposit, and the disclosure provides context; the available video evidence describes no deception connecting it to the AVAX analysis.

opening.argument: The description links a concrete reward to a viewer action: viewers are offered “FREE stocks” if they sign up for WeBull and make a qualifying deposit, with a link provided for that offer. That is not merely discussion of markets; it is a solicitation to open an account and deposit money in exchange for an advertised asset. Placing that pitch alongside AVAX analysis gives the financial commentary a route into a separate participation offer, while the description says the creator may receive a referral commission.

rebuttal.rebuttal: Calling the AVAX targets estimates does not address the separate, explicit reward-for-deposit offer. Nor does describing the link as an affiliate offer establish that the advertised “FREE stocks” are available on terms viewers can assess here; the cited material names a qualifying deposit but gives no details of the qualification or reward conditions beyond that.
